content: Finally, we demonstrated use of our models in applications, finding associations between demographics and rate of mentioning causal explanations, as well as showing differences in the top words predictive of negative ratings in Yelp reviews. Utilization of discourse structure in social media analysis has been a largely untapped area of exploration, perhaps due to its perceived difficulty. We hope the strong results of causal explanation identification here leads to the integration of more syntax and deeper semantics into social media analyses and ultimately enables new applications beyond the current state of the art.
